comments.body:
On the description box the text is:
An enormous bronze statue of the sun god Helios that stands on the port of Rhodes. It was constructed to commemorate the resistance and victory against Demetrius's siege. On its head is a circlet that represents rays of the sun. It's said that Alexander the Great was used as model for the face.
